svg.title: Experience and recognition
svg.desc: Experience: Full-Stack Developer Intern, RigorBase (Mar 2026 – Apr 2026): Built the closed-beta access system end to end: schema, OAuth 2.0, Redis rate limiting. Led the frontend migration to the v3 design system. Shipped learning-metric dashboards and adaptive quiz gamification. Technical Head / Lead Developer, Cloud Community Club (C3) @ SNIST (Nov 2024 – Present): Architected the club platform serving 1,000+ active campus users (Next.js). Automated a transactional email service with retry queues and CI/CD. Recognition: Brainrot Hackathon, Double-Track Winner (2025): 1st place in both tracks out of 1,224 entrants, for a full-stack real-time web app. JNTUH HackFusion-2K26, 5th Place Nationally (2026): Built and deployed an integrated hardware/software system in 48 hours, out of 230+ teams.
